greek_double_count.detail: Greek chapter count feeds BOTH market_opportunity (greek_opportunity, 15%) AND distribution_strength (greek_opportunity, 35%). Outreach Priority = 50% MO + 25% DS, so Greek enters Outreach Priority via two paths: (0.15 x 0.50) + (0.35 x 0.25) = 0.0750 + 0.0875 = ~16.25% of Outreach Priority derives from the same Greek signal.
greek_double_count.impact: Modestly over-weights Greek-heavy campuses in the outreach queue. It does NOT affect Market Opportunity or Growth Momentum as standalone sorts.
greek_double_count.recommendation_for_final_synthesis: Either (a) remove greek_opportunity from Market Opportunity (keep it only in Distribution, its natural home), or (b) reduce the MO Greek weight and re-normalize. Decide in the model-tuning pass, not now.

known_caveats: 2024 IPEDS completions are PROVISIONAL (no _RV yet); source year stored per row.
estimated_intro1_annual is business_bachelors x 2.4 — ESTIMATED, not measured enrollment (intro1_estimate_confidence='low').
Greek double-count between Market Opportunity and Distribution Strength (see greek_double_count).
Greek data covers only ~219/675 primary institutions; Distribution is PARTIAL for many strong markets — always read distribution_data_completeness with the score.
live_demand_score and course_readiness_score are 100% NULL (COMING_SOON); do not rank on them.
action_suppressed is 100% FALSE — no outreach/suppression events yet; not a real signal until growth_outreach_events populates.
